answer.why_different: The generated document adds schema documentation at the same schema location; this is an extra descriptive field rather than a changed enum value or a relocated constraint. The description was likely generated from the 3GPP descriptions of the enum values.
answer.spec_3gpp: The 3GPP specification provides descriptions for all four SourceIndicator values, and identifies SourceIndicator as indicating the source of the operation that led to the notification.
answer.openapi: OpenAPI 3.0 permits a Schema Object to contain a description using CommonMark syntax, so the added field is valid and appropriate documentation.
answer.clearer_why: The generated schema explains the meaning of each allowed enum value, whereas the official schema lists only the values.

evidence.title: Composition and Inheritance (Polymorphism)
evidence.text:
This object MAY be extended with [Specification Extensions](#specification-extensions).  
###### Composition and Inheritance (Polymorphism)  
The OpenAPI Specification allows combining and extending model definitions using the `allOf` property of JSON Schema, in effect offering model composition.
`allOf` takes an array of object definitions that are validated *independently* but together compose a single object.  
While composition offers model extensibility, it does not imply a hierarchy between the models.
To support polymorphism, the OpenAPI Specification adds the `discriminator` field.
When used, the `discriminator` will be the name of the property that decides which schema definition validates the structure of the model.
As such, the `discriminator` field MUST be a required field.
There are two ways to define the value of a discriminator for an inheriting instance.
- Use the schema name.

There are two ways to define the value of a discriminator for an inheriting instance.
- Use the schema name.
- Override the schema name by overriding the property with a new value. If a new value exists, this takes precedence over the schema name.
As such, inline schema definitions, which do not have a given id, *cannot* be used in polymorphism.  
###### XML Modeling  
The [xml](#schemaXml) property allows extra definitions when translating the JSON definition to XML.
The [XML Object](#xml-object) contains additional information about the available options.  
##### Schema Object Examples  
###### Primitive Sample  
```json

"type": "string",
"format": "email"
}
```

```yaml
format: email
```
